title: A Domain of Cards
summary: A small Windows domain. An open share gives you a first account; that account asks the domain for service tickets; a weak service password cracks offline and turns out to be a domain administrator. From there the domain controller is yours.
story: Castoak Supply (made up) runs a Windows domain, castoak.example, on 10.10.9.0/24. Its domain controller is WIN-DC01; a file server, WIN-APP01, shares a folder with everyone. You start on scout, a Linux box on the same network.
goal: Capture the user flag on the file server and the domain-admin flag on the domain controller.
skills: SMB shares, domain accounts, service tickets (Kerberoast-like), offline hash cracking, winrm to a domain controller

hints.text: The file server's open share hands you one ordinary domain account. In a domain, an ordinary account can ask for service tickets.
Crack the tickets offline (hashcrack); the weak one belongs to an account that is a Domain Admin on WIN-DC01.
